cat > build.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('[C]1N(C)C=CN1C'))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=3)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
pos=np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions())
origin=pos[0]
u=(pos[1]+pos[5])/2-origin;u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
v=pos[5]-pos[1];v=v-np.dot(v,u)*u;v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
w=np.cross(u,v)
local=np.stack([(pos-origin)@u,(pos-origin)@v,(pos-origin)@w],axis=1)
print('ligand',local[:7])
coords=[('Ni',np.zeros(3))]
for theta_deg,tilt in [(180,0),(60,45),(-60,-45)]:
 a=np.deg2rad(theta_deg); b=np.deg2rad(tilt)
 r=np.array([np.cos(a),np.sin(a),0]); lateral=np.array([-np.sin(a),np.cos(a),0]); normal=np.array([0,0,1])
 # rotate ligand's lateral v, perpendicular w around radial axis
 vnew=np.cos(b)*lateral+np.sin(b)*normal
 wnew=-np.sin(b)*lateral+np.cos(b)*normal
 R=np.stack([r,vnew,wnew],axis=0)
 coords.extend([(atom.GetSymbol(),1.97*r+ p@R) for atom,p in zip(m.GetAtoms(),local)])
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(coords)}\nTris(1,3-dimethylimidazol-2-ylidene)nickel(0)\n')
 for ele,p in coords:f.write('%s %.8f %.8f %.8f\n'%(ele,*p))
PY
python build.py
mkdir -p xtbrun && cd xtbrun && OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 xtb ../initial.xyz --gfn 2 --opt normal --chrg 0 --uhf 0 > xtb.log 2>&1; echo "status=$?"; tail -40 xtb.log; ls -l xtbopt.xyz

cat > multirun.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pathlib import Path
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('[C]1N(C)C=CN1C'));AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=3);AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
pos=np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions());origin=pos[0];u=(pos[1]+pos[5])/2-origin;u/=np.linalg.norm(u);v=pos[5]-pos[1];v=v-np.dot(v,u)*u;v/=np.linalg.norm(v);w=np.cross(u,v);local=np.stack([(pos-origin)@u,(pos-origin)@v,(pos-origin)@w],axis=1)
import subprocess,re,os
for tag,tilts in [('flat',[0,0,0]),('prop45',[45,45,45]),('prop70',[70,70,70]),('prop90',[90,90,90]),('mixed',[0,60,-60]),('mixed2',[90,0,0]),('opp',[0,90,-90])]:
 coords=[('Ni',np.zeros(3))]
 for theta_deg,tilt in zip([180,60,-60],tilts):
  a=np.deg2rad(theta_deg);b=np.deg2rad(tilt);r=np.array([np.cos(a),np.sin(a),0]);lat=np.array([-np.sin(a),np.cos(a),0]);normal=np.array([0,0,1]);vnew=np.cos(b)*lat+np.sin(b)*normal;wnew=-np.sin(b)*lat+np.cos(b)*normal;R=np.stack([r,vnew,wnew],axis=0)
  coords.extend([(atom.GetSymbol(),1.97*r+p@R) for atom,p in zip(m.GetAtoms(),local)])
 directory=Path('run_'+tag);directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 with open(directory/'start.xyz','w') as f:
  f.write(f'{len(coords)}\nTris(1,3-dimethylimidazol-2-ylidene)nickel(0)\n')
  for ele,p in coords:f.write('%s %.8f %.8f %.8f\n'%(ele,*p))
 with open(directory/'xtb.log','w') as f:
  p=subprocess.run(['xtb','start.xyz','--gfn','2','--opt','normal','--chrg','0','--uhf','0'],cwd=directory,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=dict(os.environ,OMP_NUM_THREADS='4'))
 if (directory/'xtbopt.xyz').exists():
  energy=float(re.search(r'energy:\s*([\d.\-]+)',(directory/'xtbopt.xyz').read_text()).group(1)); print(tag,'success',energy,flush=True)
 else:print(tag,'fail',p.returncode,flush=True)
PY
